study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized resting-state functional connectivity abnormalities unveil two major depressive disorder subtypes with contrasting abnormal patterns of abnormality

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: REST-meta-MDD consortium rsfMRI dataset (25 sites; MDD patients and HCs); COBRE schizophrenia dataset used for disease-specificity analysis
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The imaging datasets for MDD used in this study were sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/RESTmeta-MDD)"; "Finally, to examined whether extreme functional connectivity profile we reported is specific to MDD, we applied the same analysis pipeline to a dataset of schizophrenia patients from Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE, http://fcon_1000.-projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html)"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Fang2025.pdf.md: Imaging dataset and preprocessing; Fang2025.pdf.md: Reproducibility and disease specificity analysis

answer.REST-meta-MDD: HCs used to derive tolerance-interval normative ranges; MDD patients used for subtype discovery and classification

answer.COBRE: schizophrenia dataset used for disease-specificity analysis with the same pipeline

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative model based on REST-meta-MDD healthy controls; MDD cohort used for subtype analyses; COBRE used to test specificity of extreme functional connectivity patterns
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we used the 'tolerance' package in R ... to estimate nonparametric two-sided tolerance intervals for each functional connection in HCs"; "we applied the same analysis pipeline to a dataset of schizophrenia patients from Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE...)"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Fang2025.pdf.md: Identifying extreme functional connections in MDD; Fang2025.pdf.md: Reproducibility and disease specificity analysis
